name: Larco Museum
scope: Standing Museo Larco mansion at Simón Bolívar 1515, Pueblo Libre, Lima, with the garden-facing plaster front, raised entrance and nearby ramp and terrace.
era: Standing 18th-century casona, as the courtyard facade was recorded in the cleared photograph uploaded in 2010 and is documented by the museum today.

originalReview.notes: The courtyard view shows the white plaster portal, curved broken pediment, dark wooden doors, warm ramp coping, flagstaff and adjacent wall inscription and lantern. Foliage hides the ends of the façade and rear. Source caption records 2010. Embedded camera date is April 2009.

review.method: Exact creator CC0 courtyard original after searching the already-published Qualla corpus
review.notes: Searched the published Qualla article first. Its public-domain or CC0 images depict interior displays and individual artifacts. Used the exact Cherimoya.lima courtyard exterior dedicated under CC0 in the creator’s first Commons revision. The other potential historic file was excluded because its original licensing history did not establish a creator-issued public-domain release for the current version.
